title: A Kitchen for the Vow
author: Astrid Underhill
blurb: Lior Iversen, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
